existing_diagrams.assessment: Compact resolvent factorization diagram is present and legible; L2(M) → H1(M) → L2(M), the compact inclusion, and the composed K are correctly represented.
The square split into four triangles at the interior node O is present and matches the source description.
The singular-system diagram shows K and K* on the stated one-dimensional singular directions; relations match the source and are explicitly illustrative.

candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The definition distinguishes state update, input action, sampled output, and additive observation error; a small schematic could make the time indexing and separation of noise from the forward map easier to scan.
candidate_missing_diagrams.draw_check: Label states x_k and x_{k+1}; draw A:x_k→Ax_k and B:u_k→Bu_k into the update x_{k+1}=Ax_k+Bu_k; draw C:x_k→y_k; show observed ỹ_k=y_k+η_k on a separate output branch. Keep 0≤k<q−1 for updates and 0≤k<q for outputs.

candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The split/coverage definition is intrinsically a rooted-tree relation and currently has no explanatory sketch in its tile.
candidate_missing_diagrams.draw_check: Show a nonroot internal vertex v with distinct child branches c and c′, receiver r below c and s below c′, and one design C_d containing both; separately mark a covered receiver. Caption the sketch as an example of splitting/coverage, not a complete design theorem.

candidate_missing_diagrams.rationale: The three concrete sensing vectors and the all-pairs spanning condition support a concise picture; the current example is text and equations only.
candidate_missing_diagrams.draw_check: Draw arrows a₁=(1,0), a₂=(0,1), a₃=(1,1) from the origin and indicate each pair is linearly independent/spans R². Do not suggest the sketch proves phase retrieval; retain the algebraic verification.
